topics.description: Protests against the Trump administration and war in Iran are spreading across the US, with 'No Kings' rallies being held in multiple states. The protests have been met with a mixed response, with some criticizing the movement as 'Trump derangement therapy sessions'.

Allegations of fraud in Minnesota's Somali community have sparked a heated debate, with some lawmakers calling for greater oversight. The issue has also raised concerns about the role of outside funding in local communities.
